question: _________ is a game between two teams, each usually having six players, who wear skates and compete on an ice rink.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Ice Hockey**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ice hockey is a game played **on an ice rink by two teams, each with six players who wear skates.
 
• The **goal of the game **is to score more goals than the other team. 
 
• The **game is played on a rectangular rink with rounded corners.** 
 
• The rink **is divided into three sections: two end zones and a neutral zone. **
 
• **Each team has a goaltender. **
 
• The objective is to s**core goals by shooting the puck into the opponent's goal net. **
 
• **A goal is scored when the puck crosses the goal line between the posts and unde**r the crossbar. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ice skating****​**

 
 
• A standard ice hockey team during a game, when there is no overtime or penalties, consists of six players.
 
• These six players include one goaltender and five skaters.
 
• The five skaters are further divided into three forwards and two defensemen.
 
• Ice hockey is played on an ice rink, which is divided into three zones: the defensive zone, the neutral zone, and the offensive zone.
 
 
 
• **Rinkball**
 
 
• **​**Rinkball is an i**ce-based team sport that originated in Finland. **
 
• It is **played on an ice hockey rink b**ut uses equipment and rules that make it distinct from hockey.
 
• The game is a combination of elements from ice hockey and bandy, focusing more on skill and agility than physical contact.
 
 
 
• **​Ringette**
 
 
• Ringette is a** team sport played on ice, primarily in Canada, but it has gained popularity in other countries as well. **
 
• **It is known for its non-contact rules, skill-based gameplay, and use of a unique piece of eq**uipment — the ring — instead of a puck or ball.
